detail.longDescription: 🦋 NEW: # Butterfly wings create barbershop-pole style motion # illusions as they deform during flapping, shifting stripe angles and confusing # predators about speed and direction. Simulations of nearly 400 European species showed the effect is widespread, touchscreen volunteers struggled to catch virtual butterflies, and genetic # algorithms evolving over 50,000 patterns independently arrived at similar # designs found in # nature . 👉 https:// arstechnica.com/science/2026/0 9/what-butterfly-wings-have-in-common-with-barbershop-poles/ # vision # evolution # science # wings # motion # ecology # biology # research # simulation # science # wildlife # insects # entomology
